opponent.label: Constance
opponent.description: The sole surviving heiress to House Nuvelle, and one of four students that are a part of the Ashen Wolves, a secret fourth house under Garreg Mach Monastery. Constantly working to restore her fallen house and invents a number of dubiously useful magic spells to gain notoriety. Has a curious condition where her personality dramatically shifts when exposed to sunlight.
